input.quote: The Licensee shall calculate the license fee payable to the Licensor for each month based on the Monthly Notional Volume bands for that pay period and shall pay the Licensor accordingly. In no event shall the amount payable by the Licensor be less than the amount recorded by the Licensee as being traded with the Licensed Technology multiplied by the applicable Fees set forth above.
input.rationale: Fee architecture is purely usage-based and meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for usage or ordered services only). The Monthly Notional Volume bands (p0057-p0063, p0067) operate only as a volume discount on trades actually executed — reaching a higher band lowers the per-million rate; failing to reach a band simply means a higher rate on lower volume. There is no minimum volume, minimum monthly spend, take-or-pay, shortfall or true-up obligation anywhere in the document (searches for "minimum", "shortfall", "take or pay", "commit", "not less than" return nothing on point), and the "in no event ... less than" language in p0070 is an anti-underpayment floor tied to actual recorded trading, not a committed volume. The only fixed recurring charge is $2,500/month for Technical Support Services actually provided (p0086), which is an ordered-services fee rather than a purchase commitment, and Article VII(b)-(c) confirms further work is only chargeable if we agree to it in writing. "Supplemental Payments" are a 33% revenue share on amounts we actually earn from third parties, again usage-contingent, and the volume-based rebates in p0076 run in our favour. Noted but not flagged here: the 36-month initial term with renewal at Licensor's option and the absence of a Licensee termination-for-convenience right (p0049) are term/exit issues for the termination rule, not a take-or-pay commitment under this rule; the license-scope restrictions in Article II are field-of-use limits, not volume caps on our usage.
